evidence.note: MigrateLegacyRuns: flock-serialized, re-reads legacy dir under lock, never overwrites (Lstat dest -> collision), sorted report

MigrateLegacyRows: skips non-fsm and torn lines, dedups via appendRow's flocked id check so concurrent migrations cannot duplicate rows; size stamp is written with the pre-read size so a concurrent legacy append only causes an idempotent re-scan
roots() resolves anchor + common dir and runs both migrations before machine deps use the common-dir Store/Sidecar/Terminal
fromRunRunsDir: common-dir store first, single legacy main-checkout fallback with a warning; runID validated to one path segment by caller

Targeted tests pass: go test -run 'Migrate|Pending|SidecarCommon' over internal/fsm/run, internal/fsm/record, internal/fsm/machine; and -run 'ValidateFromRun|FromRunRunsDir|Session' over cmd/metareview (fromRunRunsDir covered in cmd/metareview/session_test.go)

Doc changes (INSTALL.md, commands/status.md, docs/ARCHITECTURE.md, docs/README.codex.md, docs/fsm/sdlc-loop-example.md, skills/status/SKILL.md) consistently describe the common-dir store and match the code

findings.note: MigrateLegacyRuns uses os.Rename from <main>/.metareview/runs into <git-common-dir>/metareview/runs. If the git dir is on a different filesystem than the main checkout (e.g. --separate-git-dir on another volume), Rename returns EXDEV and roots() fails every fsm command with ERR_STORE_PATH until the legacy runs are moved by hand. Uncommon setup; a copy+remove fallback or a clearer message would close it.
